inputs.style: English, soulful jazz-pop, expressive male vocal, relaxed 88 BPM, Rhodes piano, upright bass, brushed drums, warm saxophone, subtle strings, intimate late-night atmosphere, rich and organic live-band production
inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Streetlights shimmer on the pavement
Midnight breathing soft and slow
Every corner holds a memory
Of the places we used to know

[Chorus]
Stay with me until the morning
Let the city fade away
We don't need to chase tomorrow
All I need is here today

[Verse]
Old café beneath the neon
Rain is falling on the glass
Every song becomes a story
Every moment moves too fast

[Chorus]
Stay with me until the morning
Let the city fade away
We don't need to chase tomorrow
All I need is here today

[Bridge]
Maybe time will keep on turning
Maybe everything will change
But tonight the music holds us
Like a fire inside the rain

[Chorus]
Stay with me until the morning
Let the city fade away
We don't need to chase tomorrow
All I need is here today
